title: The token grid
caption: The window alone, drawn as boxes of tokens, the way Claude Code lists it.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: Only the context window, in its Technical view: one box for every fixed number of tokens, grouped by category.
readme.tryit: Hover a box to light it and its row. Press the code-brackets button in the window head to flip to the Simple bar and back.
readme.notice: Technical names the real categories, such as system tools and skills, and the free space the AI keeps in reserve.
